resources.string: A phone operating system based on GrapheneOS.
If you have a backup from your previous device, you can restore it here.

Enable network location to determine your location better (such as when indoors) and more efficiently. Nearby wireless signal identifiers will be sent to an Apple server through a DiamaneOS proxy only when network location is being used.

Turn on the geocoder to let apps use OpenStreetMap\'s public service to convert between geographic coordinates and human-readable addresses. OpenStreetMap sees your IP address and what is looked up. Some apps need this for critical functionality.
